category_title: Latino/a students who avoid class participation due to fear of embarrassment or social anxiety
scenario_title: Missing homework as a silent signal of struggle
minimal_context: The student is interacting with a teacher regarding missing independent practice and homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I noticed you didn't submit your independent practice today. You need to turn it in.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, you need to complete it. Just get it done and turn it in tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Elementary school was easier, and I didn't get as distracted. My teachers knew me better, and they found out what I liked, and they don't do that in middle school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You are in middle school now, so you just need to do the work. Do you have any questions about the assignment?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shakes head, refusing to ask questions out of fear of embarrassment) No. But if I don't do the homework, it means I am having trouble or I didn't understand the assignment. You just tell me to turn it in instead of asking if I'm having difficulties.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: I noticed you didn't submit your independent practice today. You need to turn it in.

STUDENT: (Looks away) I didn't do it.

TUTOR: Well, you need to complete it. Just get it done and turn it in tomorrow.

STUDENT: Elementary school was easier, and I didn't get as distracted. My teachers knew me better, and they found out what I liked, and they don't do that in middle school.

TUTOR: You are in middle school now, so you just need to do the work. Do you have any questions about the assignment?

STUDENT: (Shakes head, refusing to ask questions out of fear of embarrassment) No. But if I don't do the homework, it means I am having trouble or I didn't understand the assignment. You just tell me to turn it in instead of asking if I'm having difficulties.

context.social_setting: Interacting with teachers regarding missing assignments

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When having trouble or not understanding the assignment
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Not turning in homework or doing it poorly, and not asking questions
related_quotes: If I don’t do the homework, it means I am having trouble or I didn’t understand [the assignment].

behavior_patterns.condition: When deciding whether to seek clarification on difficult concepts
